import math
L = [l.split() for l in __import__("sys").stdin.read().split("\n") if l.strip()]
fs, n = int(L[0][0]), int(L[0][1])
x = list(map(float, L[1]))
best, bk = -1.0, 0
for k in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
    z = sum(x[t] * complex(math.cos(2 * math.pi * k * t / n), -math.sin(2 * math.pi * k * t / n)) for t in range(n))
    if abs(z) > best + 1e-9:
        best, bk = abs(z), k
print("%.6f" % (bk * fs / n))

import math

out = []
for i in range(n):
    g = lambda s, j: s[j] if j >= 0 else 0.0
    y = b0 * x[i] + b1 * g(x, i - 1) + b2 * g(x, i - 2) - a1 * g(out, i - 1) - a2 * g(out, i - 2)
    out.append(y)
print(" ".join("%.6f" % v for v in out))

import math
L = [l.split() for l in __import__("sys").stdin.read().split("\n") if l.strip()]
n, Lg, H = int(L[0][0]), int(L[0][1]), int(L[0][2])
